name: parra-glideator
description: Read-only paragliding planning tools powered by Parra-Glideator forecast-derived XC potential and site data.

interface.shortDescription: Rank paragliding sites by forecast-derived XC potential.
interface.longDescription: Use Parra-Glideator's read-only tools to rank and compare paragliding sites for specific dates by forecast-derived XC potential, then inspect site forecasts, historical seasonality, takeoffs and landings, and curated local resources. Decision support only: verify current conditions, local rules, airspace, access, and pilot suitability before flying.
defaultPrompt: Use Parra-Glideator to find the most promising paragliding sites within 300 km of Prague this weekend.
Use Parra-Glideator to compare 50-point XC potential at Bassano and Meduno next week.
